S2D4P.architectures.mlp.cvae module

class S2D4P.architectures.mlp.cvae.cVAE_MLP(config: cVAE_MLPConfig, input_shape: ndarray | tuple, output_shape: ndarray | tuple | None = None, added_features_dim: int | None = None)

Bases: cVAEArchABC

MLP-based conditional variational autoencoder architecture.

The architecture embeds conditioning inputs, parameterizes a posterior latent distribution from targets and conditioning information, and decodes latent samples into model outputs.

Parameters:

  • config (cVAE_MLPConfig) – Configuration defining the encoder, conditioning embedding, latent representation, decoder, and initialization behavior.

  • input_shape (np.ndarray | tuple) – Shape of each conditioning input sample excluding the batch dimension.

  • output_shape (np.ndarray | tuple | None) – Shape of each output sample excluding the batch dimension. If None, the input shape is used.

  • added_features_dim (int | None) – Number of additional features supplied alongside each sample.

forward(request: cVAEForwardRequest) → cVAEOutput

Run the training forward pass.

The conditioning input is embedded, posterior parameters are inferred from the target and conditioning representation, optional posterior variance limits are applied, and latent samples are decoded into model outputs.

Parameters:

request (cVAEForwardRequest) – Forward-pass request containing targets, conditioning data, masks, additional features, latent sample count, and optional posterior variance limits.

Returns:

Model output containing decoded predictions, posterior mean and log-variance, latent samples, and conditional prior parameters.

Return type:

cVAEOutput

predict(request: cVAEPredictRequest) → cVAEOutput

Generate predictions from the latent prior.

Latent samples and conditional prior parameters are obtained from the configured prior before the samples are decoded into model outputs.

Parameters:

request (cVAEPredictRequest) – Prediction request containing conditioning data, additional features, latent sampling settings, and prior-sampling information.

Returns:

Generated predictions and conditional prior parameters.

Return type:

cVAEOutput

class S2D4P.architectures.mlp.cvae.cVAE_MLPConfig(encoder_hidden_dims: list, latent_size: int, condition_embedding_dims: list | None = None, condition_embedding_size: int | None = None, decoder_hidden_dims: list | None = None, condition_dependant_latent: bool = False, condemb_to_decoder: bool = True, batch_normalization: bool = False, dropout_rate: float | None = None, init_method: Literal['default', 'kaiming', 'xavier', 'trunc_normal'] = 'default', activation: Literal['relu', 'gelu', 'silu'] = 'relu')

Bases: cVAEArchConfigABC

Configuration for an MLP-based conditional variational autoencoder.

Parameters:

  • encoder_hidden_dims (list) – Hidden-layer sizes used by the recognition network.

  • latent_size (int) – Size of the latent representation.

  • condition_embedding_dims (list | None) – Hidden-layer sizes used to embed the conditioning input. If None, the encoder hidden dimensions are used.

  • condition_embedding_size (int | None) – Size of the conditioning embedding. If None, latent_size is used.

  • decoder_hidden_dims (list | None) – Hidden-layer sizes used by the decoder. If None, they are derived from the encoder hidden dimensions in reverse order.

  • condition_dependant_latent (bool) – Whether the latent prior depends on the conditioning input.

  • condemb_to_decoder (bool) – Whether the conditioning embedding is supplied directly to the decoder.

  • batch_normalization (bool) – Whether MLP layers use batch normalization.

  • dropout_rate (float | None) – Dropout probability applied within MLP layers.

  • init_method (InitMethod) – Weight initialization method used when a checkpoint is not loaded.

  • activation (ActivationName) – Activation function used by the MLP networks.

property EXPECTS_MASK: bool

Indicate whether the architecture expects spatial masks.

Returns:

False because the MLP architecture does not require spatial masks.

Return type:

bool

S2D4P.architectures.mlp.deterministic module

class S2D4P.architectures.mlp.deterministic.Autoencoder(config: AutoencoderConfig, input_shape: ndarray | tuple, output_shape: ndarray | tuple | None = None, added_features_dim: int | None = None)

Bases: deterministicArchABC

MLP-based deterministic autoencoder architecture.

The architecture flattens each input sample, encodes it into a latent representation, and decodes that representation into the requested output shape. Additional features can be supplied to the encoder, decoder, or both.

Parameters:

  • config (AutoencoderConfig) – Configuration defining the encoder, decoder, feature-appending behavior, and initialization.

  • input_shape (np.ndarray | tuple) – Shape of each model input excluding the batch dimension.

  • output_shape (np.ndarray | tuple | None) – Shape of each model output excluding the batch dimension. If None, the input shape is used.

  • added_features_dim (int | None) – Number of additional features supplied alongside each sample.

forward(request: DeterministicRequest) → deterministicOutput

Run the deterministic autoencoder forward pass.

An optional input mask is applied before the input is flattened. Additional features are then concatenated to the encoder input, decoder input, or both according to append_mode.

Parameters:

request (DeterministicRequest) – Forward request containing the model input, optional input mask, and optional additional features.

Returns:

Deterministic model output reshaped to batch, channel, and flattened output dimensions.

Return type:

deterministicOutput

class S2D4P.architectures.mlp.deterministic.AutoencoderConfig(encoder_hidden_dims: list, decoder_hidden_dims: list | None = None, batch_normalization: bool = False, dropout_rate: float | None = None, append_mode: Literal[1, 2, 3] = 1, init_method: Literal['default', 'kaiming', 'xavier', 'trunc_normal'] = 'default', activation: Literal['relu', 'gelu', 'silu'] = 'relu')

Bases: ArchConfigABC

Configuration for an MLP-based deterministic autoencoder.

Parameters:

  • encoder_hidden_dims (list) – Hidden-layer sizes used by the encoder. The final value determines the latent representation size.

  • decoder_hidden_dims (list | None) – Hidden-layer sizes used by the decoder. If None, they are derived from the encoder hidden dimensions in reverse order.

  • batch_normalization (bool) – Whether MLP layers use batch normalization.

  • dropout_rate (float | None) – Dropout probability applied within MLP layers. If None, dropout is disabled.

  • append_mode (AppendMode) – Controls where additional features are concatenated. Mode 1 adds them to the encoder input, mode 2 adds them to the decoder input, and mode 3 adds them to both.

  • init_method (InitMethod) – Weight initialization method used when a checkpoint is not loaded.

  • activation (ActivationName) – Activation function used by the encoder and decoder.

property EXPECTS_MASK: bool

Indicate whether the architecture expects spatial masks.

Returns:

False because the MLP architecture does not require spatial masks.

Return type:

bool
